description: A multi-objective model to determine the optimal number and allocation of rail freight wagons: A case study is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors yasin karmanesh. In this rsearch, the modeling of determining the optimal number and allocation of freight wagons of an Iranian railway company is presented in the form of a pure integer programming model. In Section 1, a dynamic single-objective model considering the owned wagons was presented. By using GAMS software, the model was solved. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
